settings.header_color.desc: Sets the color of the header depending on the profile color.
settings.close_actions.desc: Adds 'Close Others', 'Close to the Right', 'Close Saved', and 'Close All' to the project context menu, opened by right-clicking on a project tab.
settings.pin_tab.desc: Adds 'Pin Tab' and 'Unpin Tab' to the project context menu, opened by right-clicking on a project tab.
settings.wrap_tabs.desc: Controls whether tabs should be wrapped over multiple lines when exceeding available space or whether a scrollbar should appear instead.
settings.notes.desc: Add a note to any project.
settings.per_element_notes.desc: Add notes to individual elements and show them beside the model in the 3D canvas.
settings.bedrock_open_all.desc: Adds a 'Open All' button when opening a bedrock geometry file that contains multiple models.
settings.bedrock_block_geometry.desc: Adds a File > Import action to open the geometry referenced by a Bedrock block JSON file.
settings.bedrock_entity_geometry.desc: Opens geometry and custom hit test boxes from a behavior pack entity JSON file.
settings.clear_recent_projects.desc: Adds a button beside Recent on the main screen to clear the recent projects list.
settings.issue_form.desc: Generates a prefilled form for submitting issues with Blockbench.
action.close_others.desc: Close all tabs but this one.
action.close_right.desc: Close all tabs to the right.
action.pin_tab.desc: Keep this tab open and fixed in place.
action.unpin_tab.desc: Release this tab so it can be moved or closed.
dialog.clear_recent_projects.message: Remove all projects from the Recent list? This does not delete project files.
